verdict.rationale: Fly.io markets that 'Fly Machines ... scale out to tens of thousands when the traffic arrives' and offers a 'fly scale' command for horizontal/vertical scaling, suggesting scaling capability exists, but the evidence never documents concrete load-based autoscaling policies (e.g., CPU/request-triggered auto-scale-up/down) — 'fly scale' reads as a manual operator command rather than automatic burst absorption. Community reports also describe outages and unreliable behavior under production load, undercutting confidence that bursts are absorbed smoothly. Missing for 10: documented automatic autoscaling triggers/policies, hands-on evidence of successful burst handling, and resolution of the reliability complaints during high load.
